environment.appleSwift:
Apple Swift version 6.4.2 (swiftlang-6.4.2.1.9 clang-2100.4.1.1)
Target: arm64-apple-macosx27.0.0

observations: Swift 6.3.3 compiles the source-built SwiftUI module for Android API 28 and WASI. The Android arm64 ELF links the expected symbols and WASI prints Mixer: S1.

The iOS 17.0-linked app contains both the feature using MixerSwiftUI through a target-scoped alias and AppleShell using Apple SwiftUI. Dependency scanning resolved their qualified names to the corresponding modules.
The separately built SwiftPM product-edge alias propagated to AppleShell and failed to resolve App, Scene, and WindowGroup.
The CLI export preserved all seven Swift files, including both manifests, byte for byte. All three targets rebuilt after the original checkout was removed.
cleanup: The independent detached checkout and disposable build outputs were removed.
limits: iOS compile and link used Xcode 27.2. The 27.1 release toolchain was outside this run.
Scope is the compiler fixture and public export. Production generator integration, device execution, and owned VM execution have separate checks.
